lyrics.text: I was born in the bend
In the turn of the air
The walls would sway and grin
I found a crack of color
I pressed my face against it
Like the edge of a dream
It pulled me by the wondering
It pulled me by the light
I'm the rift boy, rift boy
I'm the rift boy, rift boy
I peek and peek and peek and peek
I crept up to the opening
With my hands on the frame
The air on the other side
And I missed my wild place
My chest kept bouncing off the walls
So I held the edge of it
And mine was full of rise
I'm the rift boy, rift boy
I'm the rift boy, rift boy
I peek and peek and peek and peek
What if I'm made for motion?
I'm the rift boy, rift boy
I'm the rift boy, rift boy
I peek and peek and peek and peek
I'm the rift boy, rift boy
